test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

He was __critically__ injured in the accident.
solution: The correct answer is '**severely**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the word '**critically**' is '**severely**'. • **Critically**: in a way that expresses disapproval. (नाज़ुक तौर पर, संकटग्रस्‍त रूप से) • *Example: a **critically** ill patient...* • **Severely**: to an undesirably great or intense degree. (एक अवांछनीय रूप से महान या तीव्र डिग्री के लिए) • *Example: Our business has been **severely** affected by the slowdown.*** Correct Answer:__** *severely.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **favourably**: with approval. (अनुकूलतापूर्वक) • **trivially**: having little value or importance. (थोड़ा मूल्य या महत्व होना) • **confidently**: in a self-assured way that expresses faith in oneself or one's abilities or qualities. (एक आत्मविश्वासी तरीके से जो स्वयं पर या किसी की क्षमताओं या गुणों में विश्वास व्यक्त करता है) 46:T98d, The correct answer is '**vain**'.
